description: How the game moves between scenes. scene_manager wraps scene changes in the chosen transition.
prompt_template:
Given this animation pick:
{prior_picks.animation_style}

Generate {count} transition style options covering:
- Visual technique: cut | fade_to_black | fade_to_white | mosaic_disrupt | dither_sweep | vcr_glitch | iris_in_out | slide_directional
- Duration: instant | fast (200ms) | normal (500ms) | slow (1000ms)
- Audio behavior: silent | music_continues | music_ducks | music_swap | sfx_swoosh
- Loading mask: black_screen | scene_preview | character_portrait | custom_image

lua_implementation should be a self-contained Lua snippet showing how to perform the transition (called from scene_manager).
uses_setMosaic: true if technique includes mosaic_disrupt
uses_setInverted: true if technique=fade_to_white via inverted display
uses_stencil_image: true if iris_in_out (requires gfx.setStencilImage)

Return a JSON array of exactly {count} options matching option_schema.
refinement_prompt: Revise the transition option below per the user feedback. Keep duration_ms aligned with the duration enum and update lua_implementation accordingly.

option_schema.name: string
option_schema.technique: enum: cut | fade_to_black | fade_to_white | mosaic_disrupt | dither_sweep | vcr_glitch | iris_in_out | slide_directional
option_schema.audio_behavior: enum: silent | music_continues | music_ducks | music_swap | sfx_swoosh
